minecraftportsmod.tree.desc.campfire: The heart of the camp. People gather here in the evening.
minecraftportsmod.tree.desc.square: A paved square round the fire: benches, lamps. Needed for the Village level.
minecraftportsmod.tree.desc.well: A well in the middle of the square. Needed for the Settlement level.
minecraftportsmod.tree.desc.tent: A wool tent for two. A camp starts with these.
minecraftportsmod.tree.desc.hut: The first real house: 2 beds. Once there are two better houses, empty huts come down.
minecraftportsmod.tree.desc.house: A wooden house on a stone footing: 2 beds, roomier than a hut.
minecraftportsmod.tree.desc.storehouse: A shelter with barrels: more room for the stores with every level.
minecraftportsmod.tree.desc.storehouse_2: A closed storehouse: twice the room of a small one.
minecraftportsmod.tree.desc.mine_house: The miners' house by the rock: the mine behind it, ore. Its levels are better picks: wooden, stone, iron.
minecraftportsmod.tree.desc.wood_hut: The woodcutters' hut by the wood. Its levels are better axes: wooden, stone, iron.
minecraftportsmod.tree.desc.fish_hut: The fishers' hut on the shore. Its levels: nets, then a jetty with a boat.
minecraftportsmod.tree.desc.field: A field around a water channel. What to sow is chosen in its menu.
minecraftportsmod.tree.desc.farm: The farmstead by the fields: farmers. Each level, one more field and new crops.
minecraftportsmod.tree.desc.market: A counter under an awning. The merchant buys what the village lacks and sells what it has too much of.
